newsitem.title: UK: Ashurst surprised by MGAM stake.
newsitem.headline: Ashurst surprised by MGAM stake.

text.p: Ashurst Technology Plc, involved in integrating Western product development skills with scientific research from the Ukraine, said it was surprised at the size of the stake in the company held by Morgan Grenfell Asset Management.

The company, listed in Toronto, on the AIM makret in London, and traded over-the-counter (OTC) in New York said the size of the stake, put at "as much as 4.9" percent by MGAM could mean that MGAM has certain "follow-up" obligations in Canada.
Ashurst, formerly Emtech Ltd, said it first became aware of MGAM's possible stake when the latter issued a press release in Toronto last week.
It said all significant dealings in the shares of the company of which the company has been aware, had been reported through press releases.
Ashurst said it is unsure how MGAM may have acquired all of the shares.
The Ashurst statement follows the temporary suspension last week of three of MGAM's investment funds and the suspension of the fund managers then running them.
